masking.class: deterministic masked derivatives of native util-linux script transcripts
masking.raw: private captures named only; no unpublished raw digest is published
masking.commands: Exact captured COMMAND headers, with only marked path placeholders substituted; COMMAND_EXIT_CODE comes from the recorder footer.

scope.candidate_installs: Isolated throwaway prefixes only. The capture headers contain full env/bwrap/install commands.
scope.network: Candidate tests/invokes have --unshare-net in each captured command; candidate installers only download public artifacts. Repository packet generation, source-custody checks and synthetic publication tests run separately as coordinator operations.
scope.credentials: env -i clears inherited variables. The host home is not mounted as a directory, but two specific read-only mise paths under <host-home> provide Node and uv at /bootstrap/node and /bootstrap/uv. The captured bwrap commands expose no credential directory. Installed-host version probes are separate read-only calls.
scope.source_binding: captures/source-export-bindings.typescript:1-12 compares complete git archive exports at all three pins to the source trees, and the entire copied Headroom tests tree. Fresh test captures bind those inputs read-only.
